title: Error Handling
summary: Handle problems gracefully with try and except.

exercises.title: Bad Number
exercises.prompt: Convert `"abc"` with `int()` inside try/except. On `ValueError` print `Invalid number`.

exercises.title: Divide by Zero
exercises.prompt: Compute `10 / 0` inside try/except. On `ZeroDivisionError` print `Cannot divide by zero`.

exercises.title: Safe Double
exercises.prompt: Read one line. If it is an integer print double it, otherwise print `Not a number`.

exercises.title: else and finally
exercises.prompt: Convert `"5"` in a try block. Use `else` to print `OK` and `finally` to print `Done`.

exercises.title: Index Error
exercises.prompt: With `nums = [1, 2, 3]`, try to read `nums[10]`. On `IndexError` print `Out of range`.

exercises.title: Key Error
exercises.prompt: With `d = {"a": 1}`, try to read `d["b"]`. On `KeyError` print `No such key`.

exercises.title: Raise ValueError
exercises.prompt: Define `check_age(age)` that raises `ValueError("Age cannot be negative")` when age < 0. Call it with `-5` inside try/except and print the error message.

exercises.title: Custom Exception
exercises.prompt: Create `class InsufficientFunds(Exception)`. Raise it with the message `Not enough money` and catch it, printing the message.
hints: A custom exception inherits from Exception.

exercises.title: safe_divide
exercises.prompt: Define `safe_divide(a, b)` that returns `None` when b is 0, else a / b. Print `safe_divide(8, 2)` and `safe_divide(1, 0)` on one line separated by a space.

exercises.title: Retry Until Valid
exercises.prompt: Read lines until one is a valid integer. Print `Got <number>` for the first valid one.
hints: Use while True with try/except and break.

quiz.question: Which block runs only if no error happened?
What does int('abc') raise?
